description: Update `src/cli.ts`: add `setup` command (delegates to `runSetup()` from setup.ts, supports `--claude-code --cursor --windsurf --all -y` flags); add `update` command (runs `npm install -g zug-mcp@latest` via execSync); extend `status` to show per-agent config status (reads each MCP config file, checks for `mcpServers.zug` entry) and data dir size (du -sh). Update printUsage() to document new commands.
title: CLI — add setup and update commands
